title: Halloween Monster Egg
description: A review activity for grades 1–6. Follow these simple steps to use it with your class.
steps: Sign in to your premium account and open Halloween Monster Egg.
Choose your teams, then open Question Editor.
Add or edit each question; enter answer options and mark the correct option.
Add a picture only if needed and supported by that question type.
Review all questions and close the editor.
Set the timer and other options, then press START GAME.
Play both rounds and check the final combined scores.

sections.heading: 💾 How to export, import, or load your game data
steps: Finish editing questions in Question Editor.
Press Export JSON and save the downloaded .json file in a safe folder.
Next time, open Monster Egg and press Load JSON.
Choose the exported file and check your questions before starting.
Export again after editing so your backup contains the latest changes.

tips: The instruction JSON file in the website guides folder is NOT the same as the game-data JSON file you export.
A browser may remember changes on one device, but do not rely on that as your only backup. Export after editing whenever the game offers it.
Button labels and available editing features can differ between games. If your game does not show an export/import button, that feature has not been confirmed for that game.
